what.title: Turn on Advanced protection
what.body: Your expenses, budgets and Wealth are sealed with a key only your devices hold.
what.shared: Shared expenses and projects stay visible to the server and the people in them.
what.backups: Amounts in older backups stay for 30 days.

newPassword.title: Set a new password
newPassword.body: This password unlocks your data. We cannot reset it.

methods.title: Add a way to get back in

enable.notice: Your keys are ready. Your data is sealed when Advanced protection turns on.

recoveryKey.saveBody: Without this key or your password, nobody can open your data, including us.
recoveryKey.label: Recovery key

recover.enterBody: Enter the 9 groups, or paste the whole key.
recover.typo: Check the key for a typo.
recover.wrongKey: That is not this account's recovery key.
recover.unavailable: This account has no recovery key.
recover.newPasswordBody: Your recovery key opened your data. Choose a new password.

methods.keyBody: Saved on paper or in a file
methods.personBody: Someone who can ask for access

errors.tooMany: Too many tries, wait a minute and try again.
errors.notOffered: Advanced protection is not available here.
